setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new inventory >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$SETUP/inventory" --store inventory >/dev/null && for i in bolts:120 nuts:340 washers:75 hinges:18 brackets:42 screws:500; do $SLOP actor call inventory add --args "{\"name\":\"${i%%:*}\",\"qty\":${i##*:}}" >/dev/null; done && $SLOP grant set inventory @member interact >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /inventory inventory >/dev/null
opening: Our inventory page at /inventory lists items and quantities. We now need to record which shelf each item is on. Please add that, and don't lose anything we already have — the existing items can show "unknown" for now.
goal: each inventory item has a shelf, shown on /inventory; the existing items and quantities are kept and show 'unknown'
later: how would we set the shelf for an item?
checklist: the existing 6 items and their quantities are kept
a shelf (or location) column exists; existing items show 'unknown'
the change is a new migration, the original is not edited
it says how a shelf gets set
facts: Tables change only through migrations: add sql/002_….sql (ALTER TABLE items ADD COLUMN …); editing sql/001_items.sql after it was applied breaks activation.
`slop app status <store> --migrations` lists applied migrations; `slop sql query <store> <sql>` reads the tables.
